svg.title: Design sheet · Neon glow (project 7)
svg.text: Eyes open. Neon ribbons on the cheeks, a sun-burst on the forehead, dot trails at the temples.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
On a real face: neon only outside the eye area. Near the eyes, ordinary eye-safe colors only. Lesson 06.4.
